recommendations.title: `_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS`, `_CONSTRAINTS_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS`, `_COMPONENTS_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS`, and `_PLANS_GATE_PROMP
recommendations.body: `_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS`, `_CONSTRAINTS_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS`, `_COMPONENTS_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS`, and `_PLANS_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS` in `tests/test_roadmap.py` (step 4 "Route each carried decision only to its owning stage") carry no `check_inherited_decisions` entry, so the four parametrized `test_{domain,constraints,components,plans}_prompt_states_every_*_gate_rule` tests silently no-op for that gate — `_gate_rule_source` returns `()` and the test body's `if not subjects: return` skips the assertion entirely rather than reddening, contrary to the dict's own comment ("a gate joining a shipped gate set with no entry here reddens the parametrized case below"). No test anywhere asserts that `roadmap-domain.md`, `roadmap-constraints.md`, `roadmap-components.md`, or `roadmap-plans.md` actually state the "reproduce every supplied row exactly... do not invent deliberation" instruction the detail's `## Implementation` requires: deleting the `### Supplied inherited decisions` section from any of the four prompts currently reddens no test in the suite. This is the same gap under all four stages — the detail names one required test per stage and none exist under any name.
recommendations.suggested_action: add a `check_inherited_decisions` entry (e.g. `("reproduce every supplied row exactly", "do not invent deliberation")`) to all four `*_GATE_PROMPT_SUBJECTS` dicts in `tests/test_roadmap.py`, which the existing parametrized `test_*_prompt_states_every_*_gate_rule` tests will then exercise automatically

recommendations.title: `_run_bounded_stage_feedback()` in `plan_tool/roadmap.py` (step 4) correctly wires `carried_decisions` into its `stage.g
recommendations.body: `_run_bounded_stage_feedback()` in `plan_tool/roadmap.py` (step 4) correctly wires `carried_decisions` into its `stage.gates(_build_envelope(...))` call, and `merge_stage_feedback_revision` in `plan_tool/roadmap_revision.py` leaves unnamed rows untouched — but no test in `tests/test_roadmap.py` or `tests/test_roadmap_revision.py` exercises either property for an inherited row: none merges an unrelated feedback operation against a predecessor carrying an inherited decision and asserts that row survives byte-identical in the candidate, and none drives `_run_bounded_stage_feedback` with real gates (`run_domain_gates`/`run_*_gates`) plus a since-changed `carried_decisions` citation to prove the resulting refusal blocks publish. Separately, no test proves a carried-decision gate refusal leaves seed state, draft seeds, or promoted seeds untouched — the only existing stale-citation test, `test_later_stage_refuses_stale_lower_inherited_citation_without_writes`, exercises the distinct `_load_and_regate_below` pre-flight path, which raises before the run loop ever reaches seed materialization, so it cannot stand in for that guarantee.
recommendations.suggested_action: add `test_unrelated_bounded_feedback_preserves_inherited_row_and_regates_source` (merge an unrelated op against a predecessor holding an inherited row under real gates, assert the row is unchanged in the candidate, then repeat with a changed `carried_decisions` citation and assert the bounded-feedback route refuses) and `test_invalid_carried_decision_gate_refusal_leaves_seed_state_and_seed_files_unchanged` (drive a stage-4 run against `run_plans_gates` with a violating inherited row and assert `seed_state_path`/`draft_seeds_dir` are untouched) in `tests/test_roadmap.py`/`tests/test_roadmap_revision.py`
